Dental Clinic Website

September 04, 2025

A complete fullstack website developed for a dental clinic client, featuring React for the frontend and Node.js for the backend. The website is hosted on AWS, leveraging S3 for static file storage, Route 53 and CloudFront to deliver content with low latency and high transfer speeds.
